highlights: Create short links via POST /api/v1/links with optional custom alias and tags; support Idempotency-Key.
Redirect GET /{code} to the target URL (302 by default, 307 configurable); 404 for unknown codes, 410 for disabled or deleted links.
Read link metadata via GET /api/v1/links/{code}; disable via PATCH; soft delete via DELETE.
Liveness (GET /healthz) and readiness (GET /readyz, checks the database) probes.
Persist links in a relational database managed by reversible migrations.
content.notes: REQ-GF-001: Build a URL shortener with create, redirect, metadata and health endpoints, persistence and tests.
